field.normalization: Unit-integrated detected continuum-subtracted H-alpha surface morphology. One global luminosity in [0, 0.05] is fitted. Source pixels are divided by their angular area; no individual patch gain is fitted.
field.detection: Median of 8×8 stratified native samples per 64-pixel bin; 3-sigma positive signal above the published zero. Noise is 1.4826 MAD of horizontal bin differences / sqrt(2). Spatial differences include real structure and continuum residuals: this is a conservative fluctuation proxy, not the survey photometric error. Negative residuals remain non-detections, not emission.
field.catalogueExclusion: Any ray intersecting an existing finite gas primitive is excluded, including shell interiors. This conservative choice avoids counting its emission twice.
field.depth: The map is placed on the unchanged warped plane and integrated with the adopted 150 pc Gaussian normal thickness. No depth is extruded along the Earth direction.
field.dereddening: Conditional H-alpha correction exp(0.75 A_V / 1.085736), using OGLE red-clump internal A_V. This assumes the gas shares the tracer foreground column; gas tomography is unknown. The forward model then applies its unchanged native dust. Milky Way foreground is a common normalization here.
field.coverage: Only three targeted source cutouts. Outside support is unknown and receives no new emission. A fixed 50 pc support fade prevents hard survey edges; it is a boundary prior, not a measurement.

acceptance.explanation:
l31 starts from retained l29. Three new, WCS-qualified DeMCELS H-alpha cutouts supply the checks. G3 has a negative central continuum-subtracted median; H3 clears the trial’s conservative fluctuation threshold; I4 is positive but below that threshold. The fluctuation estimate includes real structure and subtraction residuals, so it is not a formal survey detection error. H3 intersects the existing, luminous catalogue region DEM268. The three pins do not establish a common dust-or-gas cause.

A new diffuse H-alpha field, excluding catalogue-owned emission, has no material benefit. Its continuous optimum is 1.35e-7, changing native channel values by at most 0.098 of an 8-bit display level. It remains inactive. The retained change is DEM268 brightness multiplied by 2, at the declared upper bound, with its entire 3D shape, depth and spectrum unchanged. All stars, dust, other catalogue amplitudes, RGB grades and the display curve remain fixed.

In the completed PNG evidence, H3’s pin score improves from 0.025646 to 0.024605, or 4.1%. G3 and I4 measurements are unchanged. This is partial progress: H3 remains too blue, with B/G 1.201 versus 1.030 in the photo, and the broader brown light is unresolved. The inspected side views remain coherent. Whole-image training and held-out RMS are 0.260576 and 0.322946; total light is 1.27% faint and the outer annulus remains 7.31% bright. No full-resolution fit or slab bake ran.

diagnosis.aperture: 150 pc radius for cached MCPS membership-weighted resolved plus HST-estimated unresolved BVI flux; HERITAGE nearest 56-arcsecond cell; OGLE finest containing published cell.
diagnosis.warning: Broad-band ratios are F_nu proxies, not Horálek camera RGB. Intrinsic correction uses red-clump mean reddening under the same population-depth prior; it does not measure individual stellar depths.

independentReview.scope: Read-only P0/P1 prototype review. Primary agent separately inspects the rendered evidence.
independentReview.outcome: No P0/P1 code findings. The completed artifacts pass numerical replay and frozen-field checks; primary inspection confirms coherent side views. Partial H3 retention only; G3 and I4 remain unresolved.
